answer: In an agent market trading jade, crystal, and forecasts of the next zephyr, every seller identity must lock a fixed bond for 30 days before accepting orders. Creating keys is free, but each active identity needs its own bond, so an attacker running 1,000 sellers must immobilize 1,000 times the capital. Abandoning identities does not release funds early, making repeated identity churn costly through lost liquidity and borrowing interest.
